events.title: Events
events.subtitle: Live events, history and alarms from EUROMAP machines. The Event View, inside EDU

live.clearHint: clears the live feed (persists across pages); nothing is deleted from the machine
live.empty: No live events. Cycle the machine (cycles show up as soon as they close).

history.confirmDelete:
Delete {{count}} event(s) from the machine's history buffer?

This is IRREVERSIBLE (HistoryUpdate DeleteEvent on the equipment).
history.deleteHintEmpty: check events in the list to delete them from the machine buffer
history.deleteHint: deletes the checked events from the machine buffer (irreversible)

types.connectFirst: Connect machine {{machineId}} to configure the monitored event types.
types.title: Monitored event types
types.desc1: Choose which event types feed Live, History and Kafka. Monitoring a type already includes its subtypes (OfType filter, applied on the server).
types.desc2: For each monitored type you define the publishing: which fields go in the payload, the Kafka topic, the destination connector and the message headers.
types.usingDefault: using the default: the 3 mapped EUROMAP types (cycle, box change, alarm)
types.applyNote: Modeling and destination apply right away. A new type feeds History immediately; for Live, reconnect the machine.
types.removeLastConfirm: This is the last monitored type. Removing it makes EDU monitor the default EUROMAP set again (cycle, box change, alarm). Continue?

browser.title: Event types
browser.desc: Browse the tree and check the types EDU should monitor. Entering a type shows its subtypes and the attributes each event carries.
browser.rootHint: BaseEventType is the root: monitoring it captures every event from the server. Prefer checking specific types below.
browser.subtypeHint: Monitoring a type automatically includes every subtype below it.
browser.subtypesDesc: Event classes derived from {{name}}. Check to monitor, or enter to explore.
browser.noSubtypes: {{name}} has no subtypes. It is a concrete type, the most specific level of the tree.
browser.attributesDesc: Fields that arrive in the payload of every event of this type. When you check the type, you pick and rename the published fields in the publishing config.
browser.noOwnAttributes: This type declares no attributes of its own.
browser.inheritedNote: Besides these, every event also carries the attributes inherited from the types above, such as EventId, Time, Message and Severity.

publish.platformDesc: Publications EDU produces for this machine beyond the event types: machine status and tag telemetry. Configurable the same way.

modal.title: Publishing:
modal.hint: Choose the published fields, the topic, the connector and the Kafka headers. Applies to live events and to history backfill.
modal.payloadHint: The governance fields (schema, sequence, replay, idempotencyKey) are always included.
modal.headersHint: Headers added to every published message of this type.

kafka.title: Kafka
kafka.subtitle: Kafka / Redpanda connectors, publishes the northbound UNS (acks=all) and consumes southbound commands

connections.emptyHint: Add a cluster (Kafka or Redpanda) to publish the UNS

commands.title: External commands
commands.hint: Topics on this connection that receive external commands. Method-call: publishing {machineId, objectNodeId, methodNodeId, arguments[]} invokes the OPC-UA method on the machine (ACK on imm.method-call.acks). OPC write: publishing {machineId, nodeId, value} writes the tag (ACK on imm.opc-write.acks). Both go through the arm gate and idempotency.

southbound.title: Southbound
southbound.subtitle: IT → machine commands (workorder, boxchange, recipe) with arm/disarm and ACK/NACK
southbound.banner: Commands only execute on armed machines. Disarmed or no binding configured → NACK. Arm only what you control.

methods.title: Machine methods

methods.notArmed: {{machineId}} is disarmed: method calls will be NACKed until the connection is armed.

modal.noArgs: This method takes no input arguments
modal.timeout: No response after 15s. Check the command log.
modal.emptyArray: Empty array. Increase the size to fill in elements.
